item.title: About Me
item.content:encoded:
Hello!

Thank you for your interest and for taking the time to review my technical writing portfolio.

Here's some quick info about me: I am a detail-oriented technical writer with 3+ years of IT industry experience, including Java development. Experienced in creating user manuals, release notes and API documentation, with a strong grasp of software development, documentation tools, and process flows.

Since I signed a nondisclosure agreement in my corporate job, so I can't share my tech writing outputs anywhere. I created this portfolio to address these gaps.

My writing samples include API documents and User documents. Moreover, I believe in continuous improvement, so I’ll constantly update my samples as I see fit.

This website is built using Docusaurus, Markdown, HTML, Javascript and deployed using Github.

It's still a work in progress, but I hope my technical writing portfolio gives you an insight into my tech writing skills.

Thank you!

Nisha
